key_developments: DeepSeek will launch V4 "Full Blood" versions (Flash and Pro) on July 20, with performance said to approach OpenAI's GPT‑5.6 and Anthropic's Opus 4.8.
DeepSeek V4 Pro adopts a peak‑valley pricing model, costing USD 0.87 per million output tokens under normal conditions and USD 1.74 during peak periods.
DeepSeek V4 Flash is priced at USD 0.28 per million output tokens normally, rising to USD 0.56 at peak, with cache‑hit input priced at USD 0.0028 per million tokens.
IKEA China plans to sell eight idle mainland store properties to unlock capital and reduce underutilised assets.

articles.title: AI丨DeepSeek V4「滿血版」將發布
key_points: DeepSeek is expected to release V4 "Full Blood" versions (Flash and Pro) as early as July 20, with performance reportedly approaching OpenAI's GPT-5.6 and Anthropic's Opus 4.8.
The company is introducing a "peak-valley pricing" model where DeepSeek V4 Pro output costs 0.87 USD per million tokens normally, increasing to 1.74 USD during peak times.
DeepSeek V4 Flash will be priced at 0.28 USD per million output tokens normally, rising to 0.56 USD during peak periods, with cache-hit input at 0.0028 USD.
While V4's coding capabilities are said to rival GPT-5.6 Sol, it is noted as likely underperforming compared to the recently released Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI, though at a lower price point.
